# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server: linkTo on script entities.
# map mp_carentan, gametype dm (served as probe_linkto), one client joined allies.
# Two shells, the gsc probe first, then the client about 7 s later:
#   COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PORT=29521 PROBE_SECS=95 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_linkto mp_carentan
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:29521 --probe-team allies --probe-secs 85
# probe_linkto.gsc links a script_origin (a) and a script_model (b) to the
# bombzone_A brush model *5 (entity 177) and moves it, then runs two link chains,
# a parent deleted mid-move and four links to the player, and ends on a link
# cycle, whose fatal is the last measurement. docs/research/cod11-movers.md,
# section 15, is what it measured.
# This file is the server half, games_mp.log's PROBE lines (the console's error
# block as PROBE_ERR): per server frame of a phase,
#   PROBE f <phase> <time> <parent origin> <parent angles> <a origin> <a angles> <b origin> <b angles>
#   PROBE g <phase> <time> <child origin> <child angles>
#   PROBE h <phase> <time> <k3 origin> <k3 angles> <k4 origin> <k4 angles>
# The player phases print the player's .origin and .angles as the parent.
